title: C/C++ Systems Developer
description: Engineer high-throughput, low-latency, memory-critical systems, operating system kernels, device drivers, and high-frequency trading engines using modern C and C++20.

goal.objective: Write deterministic, ultra-low-latency, and memory-managed systems code that operates directly at the hardware and operating system boundary.

learn.summary: Master C memory layout, pointer arithmetic, modern C++ (C++17/C++20), RAII, smart pointers, move semantics, template metaprogramming, POSIX threads, and Valgrind profiling.
key_competencies: Pointers, Memory Layout, Stack vs Heap & Valgrind
Move Semantics, Rvalue References & Perfect Forwarding
POSIX Threads, Mutexes, Condition Variables & Atomics
Modern Build Systems (CMake) & Compiler Optimization Flags
prerequisites: Understanding of bits, bytes, and memory

capstone_projects.title: High-Frequency Limit Order Book & Order Matching Engine
capstone_projects.description: Construct an ultra-low-latency order matching engine processing FIFO limit and market orders with microsecond execution and lock-free memory management.

capstone_projects.title: High-Performance Multithreaded In-Memory Key-Value Store with LSM-Tree
capstone_projects.description: Engineer an in-memory key-value database featuring an LSM-tree storage engine, background compaction, WAL durability, and asynchronous Linux epoll networking.

interview_focus: C++ Memory Model, std::atomic & Memory Ordering (acquire-release vs sequential consistency)
Move Semantics, Rvalue References & Perfect Forwarding (std::forward, std::move)
RAII, Smart Pointers (std::unique_ptr vs std::shared_ptr control block) & Custom Deleters
Virtual Function Tables (vtable), Dynamic Dispatch Overhead & Cache Locality
Undefined Behavior, AddressSanitizer (ASan), Valgrind & Zero-Cost Abstractions

tree.name: Foundations of C/C++ & Systems Context
tree.description: Establish an uncompromising low-level foundation: master ISO C memory models and pointers, modern C++ (C++20/C++23) RAII semantics and zero-cost abstractions, hardware register-level execution, virtual memory paging, and OS kernel boundaries.

children.name: Core C Programming & Memory Model
children.description: Master the ISO C memory model and low-level mechanics: stack vs heap allocation, pointer arithmetic, structure alignment and padding, packing with `__attribute__((packed))`, function pointer dispatch tables, bitwise manipulation for hardware bitmasks, storage classes (`static`, `extern`, `inline`), `volatile` and `restrict` semantics, memory safety hazards (buffer overruns, use-after-free, double frees), and undefined behavior traps (signed integer overflow, strict aliasing violations).

resources.title: C Programming and Memory Management - Full Course (Boot dev)

children.name: Modern C++ Language & STL
children.description: Master modern C++ (C++17/C++20/C++23) design: Resource Acquisition Is Initialization (RAII), Rule of 0/3/5, rvalue references and move semantics (`std::move`, `std::forward`), perfect forwarding, copy elision (RVO/NRVO), smart pointers (`std::unique_ptr` zero-cost abstraction vs `std::shared_ptr` atomic control block overhead and weak cycles), templates and C++20 concepts for compile-time constraints, `constexpr`/`consteval` metaprogramming, and STL cache-friendly layout (`std::vector` contiguous storage vs fragmented node containers).

resources.title: C++ Programming Course - Beginner to Advanced

children.name: Operating System Internals & Computer Architecture
children.description: Understand operating systems and CPU microarchitecture from bare metal: user vs kernel mode transitions (Ring 3 to Ring 0 via `syscall`), context switching overhead, virtual memory management (MMU, multi-level page tables, TLB shootdowns, demand paging, HugePages), CPU cache hierarchies (L1i/L1d, L2, unified L3 cache lines, false sharing, cache line bouncing), out-of-order execution, branch prediction misprediction penalties, hardware interrupts, and device drivers.

resources.title: Operating System Course for Beginners | OS Concepts Explained
Deep Learning for Computer Vision with Python and TensorFlow – Complete Course

tree.name: Core Tooling and Development Workflow
tree.description: Master the production toolchain for native engineering: the complete compilation pipeline (GCC/Clang), modern CMake target architectures, low-level hardware debugging with GDB/LLDB, and automated memory sanitizer instrumentation in continuous integration.

resources.title: Learn CMake In 20 Minutes - C++ Build Systems Tutorial
Mastering GDB in 20 Minutes - C/C++ Debugger Tutorial

children.name: Compilers, Linkers & Libraries (GCC, Clang)
children.description: Deep dive into the compilation pipeline: preprocessing, AST generation, LLVM IR/machine emission, optimization passes (`-O2`, `-O3`, `-Os`, `-flto`), and linking. Master the ELF binary format (header, `.text`, `.rodata`, `.data`, `.bss` sections), static archives (`.a`) vs shared libraries (`.so`), symbol resolution, relocation tables, Position Independent Code (`-fPIC`), Global Offset Tables (GOT), Procedure Linkage Tables (PLT), dynamic loader execution (`ld.so`, `RPATH`, `RUNPATH`, `LD_PRELOAD`), and C++ ABI name mangling.

children.name: Build Systems (Make & CMake)
children.description: Master production native build engineering: modern target-centric CMake (avoiding directory-level variables; using `target_include_directories`, `target_link_libraries` with `PRIVATE`/`PUBLIC`/`INTERFACE` visibility), generator expressions, multi-configuration builds, generating `compile_commands.json` for clangd language servers, cross-compilation toolchains (musl, ARM64), and modern C++ package managers (vcpkg in manifest mode, Conan 2.0).

resources.title: Learn C++ Build Systems: Make, CMake, and Autotools (Full Course)

children.name: Version Control with Git
children.description: Apply disciplined Git workflows for large-scale native repositories: Git submodules vs CMake FetchContent, large binary asset management with Git LFS, commit squashing, interactive rebasing, bisecting kernel and engine regressions using `git bisect run`, and atomic feature branch PR reviews.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course

children.name: Debugging & Memory Error Detection
children.description: Master low-level debugging and memory diagnostics: GDB/LLDB interactive debugging, core dump analysis with debug symbols (DWARF), setting hardware watchpoints, inspecting register state, stack frame unwinding, and running LLVM Sanitizers in CI pipelines: AddressSanitizer (ASan) for buffer overflows and use-after-free, ThreadSanitizer (TSan) for data races, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer (UBSan), and MemorySanitizer (MSan) for uninitialized memory reads.

resources.title: Master the GDB Debugger for C and C++
Learn C++ Memory Sanitizers in 10 Minutes

children.name: Unit & Integration Testing Frameworks
children.description: Implement rigorous automated testing for native systems: writing unit and parameterized tests with GoogleTest or Catch2, deterministic mocking with GoogleMock, snapshot testing, property-based testing, and test coverage profiling using `gcov`/`lcov` with target coverage gates in CI.

resources.title: Google Test C++ Unit Testing Tutorial
Catch2 C++ Unit Testing - A Quick Guide

tree.name: Advanced Systems Programming & Production Practices
tree.description: Engineer mission-critical, high-throughput systems: custom memory allocators, lock-free concurrency, kernel event multiplexing (`epoll`/`io_uring`), zero-copy IPC, CPU profiling with Linux `perf`, and hardened defensive programming.

resources.title: C++ Concurrency Tutorial - Multithreading and Parallel Programming

children.name: Advanced Memory Management
children.description: Design and implement high-performance custom memory allocators: bump/arena allocators for request-scoped workloads, freelist and slab allocators for uniform object pools, buddy allocators for dynamic block splitting, memory-mapped I/O (`mmap` with `MAP_SHARED`/`MAP_ANONYMOUS`, `madvise` and `MADV_HUGEPAGE`), cache line alignment (`alignas(64)` to eliminate false sharing), and NUMA-aware allocation using `libnuma`.

children.name: Concurrency & Parallelism
children.description: Master systems concurrency and synchronization: POSIX threads (`pthreads`) and C++ `std::jthread`, mutexes, reader-writer locks (`std::shared_mutex`), condition variables and spurious wakeups, the C++11 memory model (sequentially consistent vs acquire-release vs relaxed atomic operations), hardware memory barriers, lock-free single-producer single-consumer (SPSC) ring buffers, Compare-And-Swap (CAS) loops, and ABA problem mitigation using tagged pointers or hazard pointers.

resources.title: Introduction to Parallel Programming with TBB

children.name: Network Programming with Sockets
children.description: Build ultra-high-throughput network engines using Berkeley sockets: non-blocking socket state machines, event demultiplexing with Linux `epoll` (edge-triggered `EPOLLET` vs level-triggered), next-generation Linux `io_uring` submission and completion queue rings for zero-syscall asynchronous I/O, TCP socket kernel tuning (`SO_REUSEPORT`, `TCP_NODELAY`, `SO_RCVBUF`/`SO_SNDBUF`), backpressure handling, and binary wire protocol framing.

children.name: Inter-Process Communication (IPC)
children.description: Implement high-bandwidth, low-latency inter-process communication: POSIX shared memory (`shm_open`, `mmap`) coupled with inter-process semaphores, Unix domain sockets (UDS) with ancillary file descriptor passing (`SCM_RIGHTS`), bidirectional POSIX pipes, and zero-copy binary serialization using FlatBuffers or Cap'n Proto.

resources.title: Operating Systems Full Course | Computer Science Basics

children.name: Performance Optimization & Profiling
children.description: Profile and eliminate performance bottlenecks from software to silicon: Linux `perf` CPU sampling, generating interactive FlameGraphs, analyzing hardware performance counters (instructions per cycle, branch misses, L1/L3 cache misses), cache line profiling with Cachegrind, SIMD vectorization (AVX2/AVX-512 intrinsics using `_mm256_*`), branchless programming, and optimizing data layout (Structure of Arrays vs Array of Structures).

children.name: Code Quality, Static Analysis & Fuzzing
children.description: Enforce strict automated code quality and correctness: static analysis with Clang-Tidy (modernize, performance, bugprone, cert checks) and Cppcheck, formatting automation with `.clang-format`, coverage tracking, and coverage-guided fuzz testing with LLVM `libFuzzer` and AFL++ to discover unhandled edge cases and memory corruption vulnerabilities.

resources.title: Modern C++ Tooling - Static Analysis, Clang-Tidy, Clang-Format | CppNow 2022

children.name: Secure C/C++ Coding Practices
children.description: Engineer memory-safe systems software: understanding low-level exploit mechanics (stack-based buffer overflows, return-to-libc, ROP chains), and implementing compiler and kernel mitigations: Stack Canaries (`-fstack-protector-strong`), ASLR, Data Execution Prevention (DEP/NX), Control Flow Integrity (Clang `-fsanitize=cfi`), `_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3`, safe integer arithmetic (preventing integer truncation and wraparound), and sandboxing with Linux seccomp-bpf.

children.name: Continuous Integration/Delivery (CI/CD) for Systems
children.description: Architect enterprise CI/CD pipelines for native systems: reproducible multi-platform Docker build environments, caching compiler artifacts with ccache, running static analysis, executing parallel sanitizer test matrices (ASan, TSan, UBSan), and packaging deb/rpm/tarball release artifacts.

resources.title: CI/CD for C++ Projects with GitLab CI
Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course
Docker Crash Course For Absolute Beginners

tree.name: Portfolio, Projects & Career Path
tree.description: Demonstrate systems engineering mastery: build production-grade systems software (custom allocators, concurrent key-value stores, event-driven servers), showcase benchmark-backed GitHub repositories, and master systems design and low-level technical interviews.

children.name: Project-Based Learning & Practical Application
children.description: Build foundational systems projects from scratch: a custom Unix shell with job control, signal handling, and I/O redirection; a POSIX-compliant memory allocator replacing `malloc`/`free`; a multithreaded HTTP/1.1 static file server using raw POSIX sockets and non-blocking I/O; and a concurrent lock-free queue with comprehensive stress tests.

resources.title: Socket Programming in C - A Detailed Guide (TCP/IP)

children.name: Capstone Project: A Complex Systems Application
children.description: Capstone: Engineer an ultra-low-latency, lock-free in-memory key-value database in C++20: custom arena memory allocator with zero fragmentation, Linux `io_uring` and `epoll` event-driven network engine, multi-threaded worker pool with CPU core pinning (`pthread_setaffinity_np`), lock-free concurrent hash index with atomic compare-and-swap, append-only write-ahead log (WAL) for crash recovery, and automated benchmarking demonstrating sub-millisecond p99 latencies under 500,000 requests per second.

children.name: Career Development & Interview Preparation
children.description: Excel in systems engineering interviews: deep preparation on OS internals (virtual memory, schedulers, file systems), the C++ object and memory model (vtable mechanics, move semantics, atomics, memory orders), systems design (designing a distributed cache, log-structured merge tree, or packet broker), and writing clean, defensive, real-time code under rigorous whiteboard/pair-programming constraints.
